items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: You see, Bill used to play drums with us, you know, Pierron.

ctx.x: I mean the old man. The old man? Yeah, how did you meet him? Well, that's true.

He's much older than me, you know. Just true playing in the Pierron band. You see, Bill used to play drums with us, you know, Pierron. Bill, what was that? Bill, Matthews, the trombone player? Uh huh. So when Bill left, I don't know why he left, but anyway, I made Pierron get the old man, see, because he was the style drummer we needed in that band, see.
Who taught him to play? Who?

items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: And Peter Bocard was out there with him and all. Playing, playing, he was playing trombone too out there. And Peter said, well that's the way, you're doing good around here.

ctx.x: What was the very last job you played on drums? When the last days?

Now, well I can't, I can't exactly mention. Here in New Orleans, the last job I played on drums here in New Orleans, it was out at Trance Senior's Restaurant. Rainbag. I told P. Ron, I said, P. Ron, I'm going away. I'm going to take me a trip. I got a chance to develop all my trombone better. And Peter Bocard was out there with him and all. Playing, playing, he was playing trombone too out there. And Peter said, well that's the way, you're doing good around here. And we all used to go home together every night. I…

He's a tall fella in California. He played with the boy. He played with the boy. He played with the one day at the Bunk once. I heard him with Mason Records. He played with the Honey Drippers. Those records we played with Wade Whaley, Frank Paschley's own job.

items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: he was playing drums with us

ctx.x: I bet you recognize it. Who's the drummer?

Bill Matthews. Oh man. That's right. Saw him last night. You dog. It says Bill, he was playing drums with us. Let me read this again. Maison Blanche presents for the pleasure of their patrons, Piron's Jazz Jam of Tranchina fame.
